items.title: Postal Service moves to finalize mail ballot regs before SCOTUS ruling
items.summary: The rules have already been rejected by multiple state courts, but the Trump administration said it’s preparing in case of a favorable Supreme Court decision. The post Postal Service moves to finalize mail ballot regs before SCOTUS ruling appeared first on CyberScoop .

items.title: TikTok Agrees to $400 Million Settlement in U.S. Child Privacy Lawsuit
items.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice (DoJ) announced on Friday that ByteDance-owned TikTok will pay $400 million to settle a 2024 lawsuit accusing the company of violating child privacy laws in the country. items.title: Hackers infect Android car head units with proxy botnet malware
items.summary: A supply-chain attack targeting Android-based car head units is using a legitimate device-update app to spread malware that enlists compromised devices in a proxy botnet or uses them for ad fraud. [...]
